mapper.select: SELECT a.id AS application_id, a.student_id, a.job_posting_id, s.name AS student_name, a.status, j.company_name, j.title, ad.document FROM application a JOIN student s ON s.id = a.student_id JOIN job_posting j ON j.id = a.job_posting_id LEFT JOIN application_document ad ON ad.application_id = a.id WHERE a.id = #{applicationId}
SELECT id AS application_id, student_id, status FROM application WHERE id = #{applicationId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE application SET status = 'APPROVED', reviewed_at = #{reviewedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, reject_note = NULL WHERE id = #{applicationId} AND CAST(status AS BINARY) = 'SUBMITTED'

UPDATE application SET status = 'REJECTED', reviewed_at = #{reviewedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, reject_note = #{note,jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR} WHERE id = #{applicationId} AND CAST(status AS BINARY) = 'SUBMITTED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO contact_log (student_id, contact_type, note, created_at) VALUES (#{studentId}, 'MESSAGE', #{note,jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR}, #{createdAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP})
